reasons.plausibility: Al-induced BCC formation for improved strength, creep, and corrosion is supported by known HEA behavior, though high Al fraction could risk brittleness, so some uncertainty remains.
reasons.testability: It is straightforward to produce comparable alloys with and without Al doping and measure the mechanical and electrochemical changes against the defined performance thresholds.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis directly targets a key problem in aerospace fasteners with a clear, single-variable intervention and concrete metrics to evaluate.
